import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import (
    StandardScaler,
    OneHotEncoder,
    LabelEncoder,
    MinMaxScaler,
)
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare train and test datasets
train_id = train_df["id"].values.copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].values
X_train_full = train_df.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1).copy()

test_id = test_df["id"].values.copy()
X_test = test_df.copy()
test_target = sample_submission[
    ["id", "target"]
]  # Copy target column from sample for format

# Get common feature names (excluding id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != "id" and col != "target"]

# Preprocessing setup
scaler_float = StandardScaler()
scaler_int = MinMaxScaler()

# Initialize scalers
scaler_float.fit(X_train_full.select_dtypes(include="float").iloc[:, :])
scaler_int.fit(X_train_full.select_dtypes(include="int").iloc[:, :])

# Apply scaling to training data
X_train_scaled = X_train_full.copy()
for col in feature_cols:
    if X_train_scaled[col].dtype == float:
        X_train_scaled[col] = scaler_float.transform(X_train_scaled[[col]])
    elif X_train_scaled[col].dtype == int:
        X_train_scaled[col] = scaler_int.transform(X_train_scaled[[col]])

    # Categorical f_27
    if col == "f_27":
        cat_encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown="ignore")
        X_train_scaled[col] = cat_encoder.fit_transform(X_train_scaled[[col]]).flatten()

# Split data: 0.7 train / 0.3 val
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_scaled.values, y_train, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Scale and encode test data using same parameters
X_test_scaled = X_test.drop("id", axis=1).copy()
for col in feature_cols:
    if X_test_scaled[col].dtype == float:
        X_test_scaled[col] = scaler_float.transform(X_test_scaled[[col]])
    elif X_test_scaled[col].dtype == int:
        X_test_scaled[col] = scaler_int.transform(X_test_scaled[[col]])

    # Categorical f_27
    if col == "f_27":
        cat_encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown="ignore")
        X_test_scaled[col] = cat_encoder.transform(X_test_scaled[[col]]).flatten()

# Convert to array formats for model
X_train_arr = X_train.astype(np.float32)
X_val_arr = X_val.astype(np.float32)
X_test_arr = X_test_scaled.astype(np.float32)

# Train XGBoost on training data only (NOT including validation)
model = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    min_child_weight=3,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    scale_pos_weight=(y_train == 0).sum() / (y_train == 1).sum(),
    eval_metric="auc",
    random_state=42,
)

# Fit only on training data
model.fit(X_train_arr, y_train.ravel(), verbose=False)

# Validate on TRUE HOLD-OUT VALIDATION SET (not trained on!)
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_arr)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)

print(f"AUC-ROC on hold-out validation set (trained data excluded): {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set WITHOUT touching test data during training
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test_arr)[:, 1]

# Save submission file to required directory
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df["target"] = test_preds
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
